# dc-b1l: FIELDVALUE of values that are no linked data type, read through ERROR.TYPE: a number, a
# text, a logical, an error, a blank cell and a LAMBDA, field names of each kind, an error as the
# field name, and arrays at either argument.
ERROR.TYPE(_xlfn.FIELDVALUE(1,"x"))
ERROR.TYPE(_xlfn.FIELDVALUE("a","x"))
ERROR.TYPE(_xlfn.FIELDVALUE(TRUE,"x"))
ERROR.TYPE(_xlfn.FIELDVALUE(NA(),"x"))
ERROR.TYPE(_xlfn.FIELDVALUE(1,NA()))
ERROR.TYPE(_xlfn.FIELDVALUE(1/0,NA()))
ERROR.TYPE(_xlfn.FIELDVALUE(1,5))
ERROR.TYPE(_xlfn.FIELDVALUE(1,""))
ERROR.TYPE(_xlfn.FIELDVALUE(Data!D1,"x"))
ERROR.TYPE(_xlfn.FIELDVALUE(Data!A1:A3,"x"))
ROWS(_xlfn.FIELDVALUE({1,2;3,4},"x"))
COLUMNS(_xlfn.FIELDVALUE({1,2;3,4},"x"))
ERROR.TYPE(INDEX(_xlfn.FIELDVALUE({1,2;3,4},"x"),2,2))
ROWS(_xlfn.FIELDVALUE(1,{"a";"b";"c"}))
ERROR.TYPE(INDEX(_xlfn.FIELDVALUE(1,{"a";"b"}),2,1))
ERROR.TYPE(_xlfn.FIELDVALUE(_xlfn.LAMBDA(_xlpm.x,_xlpm.x),"x"))
ROWS(_xlfn.FIELDVALUE(Data!A1:A3,"x"))
_xlfn.FIELDVALUE(Data!A1,"x")

# dc-b1l, 2026-10-30: OFFSET and INDIRECT lifted over an array give an array of references (over
# Data!E1:E3 holding 1, 2 and 3, and Data!A1:A3 holding 1, 5 and 3), read in a legacy formula.
SUM(OFFSET(Data!E1,{0,1,2},0))
SUM(OFFSET(Data!E1,{0;1},0,2))
COUNT(OFFSET(Data!E1,{0,1,2},0))
COUNTA(OFFSET(Data!E1,{0,1,2},0))
MAX(OFFSET(Data!E1,{0,1},0,2))
AVERAGE(OFFSET(Data!E1,{0,1,2},0))
ROWS(OFFSET(Data!E1,{0;1;2},0))
ISREF(OFFSET(Data!E1,{0;1},0))
SUM(SUBTOTAL(9,OFFSET(Data!E1,{0;1},0,2)))
SUMPRODUCT(SUBTOTAL(9,OFFSET(Data!E1,{0;1},0,2)))
SUBTOTAL(9,OFFSET(Data!E1,{0;1},0,2))
SUMPRODUCT(N(OFFSET(Data!E1,{0;1;2},0)))
SUM(N(OFFSET(Data!E1,{0;1;2},0)))
N(OFFSET(Data!E1,{0;1;2},0))
SUM(SUMIF(OFFSET(Data!E1,{0;1},0,2),">1"))
SUMPRODUCT(COUNTIF(OFFSET(Data!E1,{0,1},0,2),">1"))
SUMPRODUCT(AREAS(OFFSET(Data!E1,{0;1},0)))
SUMPRODUCT(ROW(OFFSET(Data!E1,{0;1},0)))
SUM(INDIRECT({"Data!E1","Data!E2","Data!A2"}))
SUM(INDIRECT({"Data!E1:E2","Data!A1:A2"}))
SUMPRODUCT(SUBTOTAL(9,INDIRECT({"Data!E1:E2";"Data!A1:A2"})))
SUM(OFFSET(Data!E1,{0,1,2},0)*1)
INDEX(OFFSET(Data!E1,{0;1},0,2),1,1)
SUMPRODUCT(INDEX(OFFSET(Data!E1,{0;1},0,2),1,1))
T(OFFSET(Data!B1,{0;1},0))
SUMPRODUCT(--ISNUMBER(N(OFFSET(Data!E1,{0;1;2},0))))
# dc-b1l, 2026-10-30: aggregate functions below an array place (SUMPRODUCT, ROWS, INDEX) in a legacy
# formula, over Data!E1:E3 holding 1, 2, 3 and Data!A1:A3 holding 1, 5, 3.

INDEX(SUM(Data!E1:E3*2),1)

SUMPRODUCT(PRODUCT(Data!E1:E3))
SUMPRODUCT(SUMSQ(Data!E1:E3))
SUMPRODUCT(COUNTA(Data!E1:E3))
